name: Isudemoki
source:
You're a college student with a somewhat peculiar life. If you thought the world had already given you enough problems, you're very wrong. 

Your life is about to be invaded by a cute demon who will offer you a contract. But be careful, getting involved with these beings could turn your life into a complete mess.

[From [url=https://geumi-studio.itch.io/isudemoki]itch.io[/url]]
